scope.dimension: Every integer n >= a fixed n0
scope.density_parameter: Every real 1 <= R <= c0 n log n
scope.patterns: Every P in the original F_n, as an indexed list with repetitions
scope.conclusion: Pr(coverage of B_D by P+K_plus) <= exp(-exp(gamma*n-Ctail*log(n)))
angular_conditions: All distinct selected targets: every cross-residual projective angle > H sqrt(log(n)/n)

structural_extension.center_lists: Arbitrary deterministic indexed finite lists in R^n, not required to lie on the rounding grid.
structural_extension.hypotheses: For fixed B,k0>0: N<=n^k0 exp(lambda0 n); a measurable G subset B_D has volume at least |B_D|/4; all residuals on G have length >=r_minus-2 eta; the relevant radial weight sum is <=B R.
structural_extension.conclusion: For all sufficiently large n and 1<=R<=c0(B,k0)n log n, the same per-list tail holds with Ctail=2k0+5/2.
structural_extension.not_claimed: Simultaneous exclusion of an uncountable adaptive family.

jacobian.interpretation: A finite matching-multiplicity check only, not a proof of the all-parameter proposition.

formal_core.scope: All finite labeled directed partial matchings and real weights a_i>=1, w_ij>=0; no distinct-slot-set or symmetry assumption.
